In Daniel, it describes the beasts of the field whose grass Nebuchadnezzar ate during his period of madness (Dan 4:25, 32, 33; 5:21). Spanish 'toros/bueyes' and French 'taureaux/boeufs' consistently render the bovine livestock sense."
